redfin-mcp 0.4.0 — Add Redfin real-estate search and user activity lookup via MCP

- Search Redfin for real-estate listings, property records, and market reports using natural-language requests.
- Retrieve your saved homes and searches by bridging through your signed-in Redfin.com session (via fetchproxy extension).
- Returns details like price, beds/baths, square footage, year built, address, and status for each listing.
- Includes a local mortgage calculator with payment breakdowns.
- No API keys required; routes requests through your own browser tab for compatibility.
- Read-only access to Redfin data; does not support saving homes or searches yet.
